I wanted to approach the problem differently.
Introducing Cindervale, an open-source Visual Studio Code theme built around a simple idea: the entire editor should feel like one coherent visual environment, not just a code window with a different background.
Cindervale is now published on the Visual Studio Marketplace, and the source code is available on GitHub.

title: Use an AI Assistant on Client Work Without Sounding Like an AI
summary:

The even pacing, the em-dash tics, the sentences that all weigh the same: whatever you feed a capable model, what comes back sounds like a capable model, and your client reads a dozen of those a day.
